name: Linear A
notes: Used on Crete and some Aegean islands, associated with Minoan civilization; corpus of roughly 1,400-1,500 inscribed objects (~7,300-7,400 signs), overwhelmingly short administrative/votive texts. Coded INDEPENDENT reflecting its internal Cretan development (as opposed to Linear B, which adapts Linear A's own signary for Greek — see ws_linear_b); Linear A's own relationship to the earlier, less-understood Cretan Hieroglyphic script is a separate, lower-certainty internal-evolution question not resolved by this research batch.
